Man: Hello. I ordered twenty office chairs last week, but only fifteen arrived. Woman: I am sorry. The remaining five are at our warehouse. We can deliver them on Thursday at no extra charge. Man: Thursday works, as long as they arrive before noon.

Woman: Have you tried the new cafe across from the station? Man: Not yet. Does it have vegetarian options? Woman: Yes, and it is offering a discount this week. Shall we go there for lunch? Man: Good idea. I finish my client call at twelve fifteen.

Woman: We are almost out of printer paper. Should I order our usual ten boxes? Man: Make it fifteen this time. The training team needs extra copies next month. Woman: The supplier offers free delivery for orders of twelve boxes or more. Man: Great. Please place the order before lunch so it arrives tomorrow.

Man: My flight lands at six, but the conference dinner begins at seven. Will I have time to check in at the hotel? Woman: The airport shuttle takes forty minutes. You should go straight to the restaurant. I can ask the hotel to hold your room. Man: Thank you. Can I leave my suitcase at the restaurant? Woman: Yes, they have a cloakroom near the entrance.

Customer: I bought these headphones yesterday, but the left side has no sound. Assistant: I am sorry about that. Would you like a refund or a replacement? Customer: A replacement, please. I need them for a trip tomorrow. Assistant: We have the same model in black, but the blue version will not arrive until Friday. Customer: Black is fine. Here is my receipt.

Woman: We have forty-eight registrations, but room two seats only forty. Man: Room five holds sixty, and it is free that afternoon. Woman: Perfect. Does it have microphones? Man: Yes, but we need to request them from the events team by Wednesday. Woman: I will email them now and update the room number on the invitations.

Man: The interview with Ms. Sato is set for Thursday at eleven. Woman: I have a client visit then. Could we move it to one thirty? Man: She said she is available after lunch. I will call her to confirm. Woman: Thanks. Please also send her the updated job description. We have added responsibility for the monthly newsletter.

Woman: The glass containers arrived, but two cartons are damaged. Man: Did you take photos before unpacking them? Woman: Yes. I also noted the damage on the delivery form. Man: Good. Send the photos and form to the supplier. They said they can send replacements within three working days. Woman: I will do that before I update the inventory.

Woman: My reimbursement is lower than the amount I claimed. Man: Let me check. Your hotel and train expenses were approved, but the taxi receipt is missing. Woman: I uploaded it separately this morning. Man: That was after yesterday’s processing deadline. We will include the taxi fare in next Friday’s payment. Woman: All right. I will keep the original receipt until then.

Man: The booking app keeps closing when I try to add a room. Woman: Which version are you using? Man: Version four point one. Woman: That issue was fixed in four point two. Please update the app first. If it still happens, send me a screenshot of the error message. Man: Will I lose my existing bookings? Woman: No, they are saved on the server.

Woman: Our floor is too warm again. Have you heard from Facilities? Man: A technician checked the air conditioner this morning. It needs a replacement part that arrives on Tuesday. Woman: We have a client presentation on Monday. Man: Room eight on the ground floor has working air conditioning. I can reserve it for you. Woman: Please do. We need it from ten to noon.

Man: The brochure is ready, but I noticed the old support number is still on the back page. Woman: Thank you for catching that. Have we sent the file to the printer? Man: Not yet. They need it by four to deliver the brochures on Friday. Woman: I will correct the number now. Could you check the website address as well? Man: Certainly. I will send the final file after your correction.

recordings.text: Woman: I booked the meeting room for ten, but the projector is not working. Man: I can ask the technician to take a look. Woman: Thanks. If it cannot be fixed, we can move to room six. Man: I will let you know before nine thirty.

Man: Hello. I ordered twenty office chairs last week, but only fifteen arrived. Woman: I am sorry. The remaining five are at our warehouse. We can deliver them on Thursday at no extra charge. Man: Thursday works, as long as they arrive before noon.

Woman: Have you tried the new cafe across from the station? Man: Not yet. Does it have vegetarian options? Woman: Yes, and it is offering a discount this week. Shall we go there for lunch? Man: Good idea. I finish my client call at twelve fifteen.

Woman: We are almost out of printer paper. Should I order our usual ten boxes? Man: Make it fifteen this time. The training team needs extra copies next month. Woman: The supplier offers free delivery for orders of twelve boxes or more. Man: Great. Please place the order before lunch so it arrives tomorrow.

Man: My flight lands at six, but the conference dinner begins at seven. Will I have time to check in at the hotel? Woman: The airport shuttle takes forty minutes. You should go straight to the restaurant. I can ask the hotel to hold your room. Man: Thank you. Can I leave my suitcase at the restaurant? Woman: Yes, they have a cloakroom near the entrance.

Customer: I bought these headphones yesterday, but the left side has no sound. Assistant: I am sorry about that. Would you like a refund or a replacement? Customer: A replacement, please. I need them for a trip tomorrow. Assistant: We have the same model in black, but the blue version will not arrive until Friday. Customer: Black is fine. Here is my receipt.

Woman: We have forty-eight registrations, but room two seats only forty. Man: Room five holds sixty, and it is free that afternoon. Woman: Perfect. Does it have microphones? Man: Yes, but we need to request them from the events team by Wednesday. Woman: I will email them now and update the room number on the invitations.

Man: The interview with Ms. Sato is set for Thursday at eleven. Woman: I have a client visit then. Could we move it to one thirty? Man: She said she is available after lunch. I will call her to confirm. Woman: Thanks. Please also send her the updated job description. We have added responsibility for the monthly newsletter.

Woman: The glass containers arrived, but two cartons are damaged. Man: Did you take photos before unpacking them? Woman: Yes. I also noted the damage on the delivery form. Man: Good. Send the photos and form to the supplier. They said they can send replacements within three working days. Woman: I will do that before I update the inventory.

Woman: My reimbursement is lower than the amount I claimed. Man: Let me check. Your hotel and train expenses were approved, but the taxi receipt is missing. Woman: I uploaded it separately this morning. Man: That was after yesterday’s processing deadline. We will include the taxi fare in next Friday’s payment. Woman: All right. I will keep the original receipt until then.

Man: The booking app keeps closing when I try to add a room. Woman: Which version are you using? Man: Version four point one. Woman: That issue was fixed in four point two. Please update the app first. If it still happens, send me a screenshot of the error message. Man: Will I lose my existing bookings? Woman: No, they are saved on the server.

Woman: Our floor is too warm again. Have you heard from Facilities? Man: A technician checked the air conditioner this morning. It needs a replacement part that arrives on Tuesday. Woman: We have a client presentation on Monday. Man: Room eight on the ground floor has working air conditioning. I can reserve it for you. Woman: Please do. We need it from ten to noon.

Man: The brochure is ready, but I noticed the old support number is still on the back page. Woman: Thank you for catching that. Have we sent the file to the printer? Man: Not yet. They need it by four to deliver the brochures on Friday. Woman: I will correct the number now. Could you check the website address as well? Man: Certainly. I will send the final file after your correction.
